name: Banh mi op la
summary: Bánh mì ốp la is a fried egg with bread, eaten at a breakfast counter on Da Nang’s Huỳnh Thúc Kháng.
origin: Da Nang’s breakfast street, a plate of its own beside the filled bánh mì.
howToEat: Eat it at a counter in the morning on Huỳnh Thúc Kháng.
where: Huỳnh Thúc Kháng, in the morning. The street is busiest from about 06:00 to 08:00, and counters serve until around noon.
seoTitle: Banh mi op la — fried egg on the breakfast street
seoDescription: Bánh mì ốp la is a fried egg with bread, the breakfast on Huỳnh Thúc Kháng.
